meta.name: apollo-migration-deep-dive
meta.description:
Comprehensive Apollo.io migration strategies.
Use when migrating from other CRMs to Apollo, consolidating data sources,
or executing large-scale data migrations.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo migration", "migrate to apollo",
"apollo data import", "crm to apollo", "apollo migration strategy".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并执行从其他CRM迁入Apollo的数据迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正打算把客户数据从其他CRM迁到Apollo
copy.tagline_en: Plan and execute data migration from other CRMs to Apollo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving customer data from another CRM to Apollo

howto.what: Claude 会读取 Apollo 迁移实施指南，输出迁移前评估、字段映射、分阶段迁移、批处理、验证与回滚方案；并要求已有 Apollo API 凭据且完成 apollo-install-auth 设置。
howto.when: 当用户提到 "apollo migration"、"migrate to apollo" 等关键词，或要求从其他 CRM 迁移到 Apollo、整合数据源、执行大规模数据迁移时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Salesforce 的数据迁移到 Apollo
say.note: Claude 会给出迁移前评估和分阶段迁移策略。

say.text: 从 HubSpot 导入数据到 Apollo，怎么设计字段映射？
say.note: Claude 会输出字段映射配置和批处理方案。

say.text: 我要做大规模数据迁移，请给出验证和回滚方案
say.note: Claude 会提供验证对账及回滚步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the Apollo migration implementation guide and provides a pre-migration assessment, field mapping, phased migration, batch processing, validation, and rollback plan. It requires Apollo API credentials and a completed apollo-install-auth setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions phrases like "apollo migration" or "migrate to apollo", or asks to migrate from another CRM to Apollo, consolidate data sources, or run large-scale data migrations.

say_en.text: Help me migrate my Salesforce data to Apollo
say_en.note: Claude provides a pre-migration assessment and phased plan.

say_en.text: How should I map fields for importing HubSpot data into Apollo?
say_en.note: Claude will output field mappings and batch plans.

say_en.text: I need a validation and rollback plan for a large data migration
say_en.note: Claude will provide reconciliation and rollback procedures.
